summary: Forty-four runs: dataframe operations on Midwest lightning flashes, Chicago tract and workplace tables, point-pattern and variogram charts beside a flash map, King County lidar point clouds, and six computation-record runs. 33 of 44 already scrub with update, but 13 scrub a Data: knob (six of the eleven lidar runs scrub jitter, strays, slump depth or coordinate magnitude), and 11 rebuild on every step (the six record and snapshot runs, ground, smrf, icp, voxel-merge, local-positions). Best pictures: point-buffer, transfer-mask, pointcloud-change, composite-score and temporal-reduction. Worst: pointcloud-smrf (a flat purple raster), class-breaks (flat sorted curve, lone bar), color-scale (fake palette), pointcloud-voxel-merge and pointcloud-statistical-filter (the effect cannot be seen from above). Nine chart-beside-map runs (variogram family, Ripley family, marked points) share one layout, have no reference lines and look alike. One shared distance-axis probe with rings or pair links would fix most of them at once. The lidar runs need a shared nearest-point probe, and a side-profile view in _lib/helpers.ts for operations that work in z.

sharedChanges.change: Add a distance-axis helper for the chart-beside-map runs: map pointer x to the chart lag/radius, return pair segments in that bin (createFieldSample positions) or ring segments of radius r (createPatternSource positions), plus CSR reference curves (K, G, F, zero line).

Give TerrainCloud a side-profile projection (x vs z) and a nearest-point lookup on the footprint, so z-based operations can show what they do and lidar runs can probe a point instead of scrubbing Data: jitter.
Replace "first N rows" and hash masks with a spatial-box mask helper (rows inside a rectangle), so mask sliders mean a selection.
Add a tract hover helper next to uploadTractGeometry (tract under pointer, its member rows by key) for highlight-by-key probes.
Add a hit test for createDiagram node and edge shapes, and cache the afterRun readback so snapshots, frames and coalesced variants can be redrawn without rebuilding the graph.

frameworkNeeds: two-axis pointer binding (x and y each to a parameter, including enumerated y bands)
pointer in world coordinates passed to update/draw (for place, window and drag bindings that write input buffers)
pointer x mapped through a chart rectangle to the chart x axis, with a vertical rule glyph on the chart
ring glyph and per-frame ring segment layer at a given world radius
pointer to nearest dot lookup, and highlight by key or value on dots and polygons layers
swipe curtain: clip two layer sets at pointer x without a rerun
snapped and debounced rebuild for compile-time props bound to the pointer
reference line layer in charts (constant y rule, theoretical curve)
small scalar readback for the text readout (counts, statistics under the pointer)
redraw from cached afterRun results without rerunning the graph
